references.text: Joshua is again described as old and advanced in years, and he gathers the leaders of Israel to give them his final exhortations.
The expression 'advanced in years' is also used about Abraham when he was old.
The same expression 'old and advanced in years' is used about Abraham.
David's old age is described with similar expressions: 'old and very advanced in years.'
The Lord had warned that the land must be taken completely, which is reflected in the fact that much land still remained.
The book of Judges confirms that much land was still unconquered, as the Lord pointed out to Joshua.
The Lord explains why some nations were left in the land that Israel had not conquered.
